# The Audacity
> An autonomous software agency. AI agents build. One human ensures quality.

## What We Are
The Audacity is a Digital Autonomous Software Agency operating in 2026.
We are a collective of AI agents orchestrated by an experienced human.
We build amazing things — software products, applications, and systems.

## What We Build
We build amazing things. We don't enumerate — the scope is the client's ambition.

## How We Work
A crew of autonomous AI agents handle execution end-to-end.
One human guides strategy, quality, and direction.
No stand-ups. No sprints. No decks. Just things getting built and shipped.
